text:
lisa_support: customer reported large discrepancy between invoice token counts and dashboard numbers — invoice 1,120,403 tokens for org_4567, dashboard shows ~112,000. filing as urgent, customer is asking for a refund path.
omar_finance: thanks lisa. please add invoice id and any customer-provided request ids. we need to know if this is a metering or billing post-processing issue.
lisa_support: invoice_id INV-2026-03-07-9987, customer provided two request-ids: rq_7f3a and rq_7f4b. they pasted a CSV of usage rows they see in dashboard: sample included. customer insists tokens were miscounted by factor ~10.
ingrid_billing: tagging finance. @omar_finance — prelim note: if metering bug, we'll need provisional credit and a revrec adjustment note. can we confirm scope before committing amount?
devon_engineer: pinging eng. can we get full usage-event export for org_4567 for date range 2026-03-01..2026-03-07 plus ledger entries linked to INV-2026-03-07-9987? I want the raw events to check ingestion/dedupe.
sam_infra: I'll run the export from the ledger service. attaching quick query: 
```sql
SELECT * FROM usage_events
WHERE org_id='org_4567'
AND timestamp >= '2026-03-01' AND timestamp < '2026-03-08';
```
will push CSV to /internal/exports/org_4567_march.csv (internal link).
metering-bot: alert: a deploy to metering-ingester happened 2026-03-05T04:22:11Z (deploy-345). Potential schema change: change in streaming retry behaviour.
devon_engineer: noted. timeline fits. customer invoice covers that window and discrepancy magnitude matches double-count pattern seen in recent ingest retries. need to check if streaming consumer emitted duplicate usage_events when stream reconnect happened. looking for repeated request-ids.
lisa_support: customer-supplied logs show repeated request-id rq_7f3a across 11 events. forwarding in thread.
devon_engineer: that matches. hypothesis: the client retried with same request-id but our consumer accepted both events due to a missing dedupe key in the new ingester build from deploy-345. reproducer steps for infra: spin up the ingester at deploy-345 and run this local test payload with chunked streaming and a reconnect after 500ms. payload: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://ingest.redwood.internal/v1/usage -H "Authorization: Bearer test" -d @payload.json --header "X-Request-ID: rq_7f3a"
# then force reconnect and replay the same request id
```
expectation: should be deduped; observed: two events accepted.
sam_infra: can reproduce locally with deploy-345 image. confirmed duplicated events when the ack path races with reconnect. escalating.
ingrid_billing: if duplicated, what's the impact on invoices? do we auto-aggregate raw events or run dedupe before ledger?
devon_engineer: pipeline ingests raw events into raw_events table and runs a dedupe job before ledgerization. dedupe job failed to find duplicates because the dedupe-key calculation changed (now includes a sequence marker that varies on reconnect). so duplicates passed through to ledger and were counted twice.
omar_finance: ok. candidate resolution: provisional credit the customer for duplicated tokens and then run a backfill dedupe + ledger reconciliation. how do we quantify duplication?
devon_engineer: I extracted sample counts: raw ledger token_total for org_4567 on 2026-03-05 = 560,201 tokens. deduped expected = ~56,020 tokens (roughly 10x). full backfill will produce corrected ledger token_total = 112,030 for bill window. I'll attach full CSV to the ticket.
lar: (note: lar is not a participant; ignore)
omar_finance: please propose provisional credit amount. finance will author a revrec note for the adjustment and needs line items: original invoice amount, credit amount, reason, JEs.
iningrid_billing: suggested wording for revrec note draft: 
"Reason: Duplicate usage events were recorded due to a regression in the metering ingester deployed on 2026-03-05 (deploy-345). Impact: Token usage for org_4567 was over-counted by ~1,008,373 tokens. Action: provisional credit issued in amount $1,120.00 while backfill and reconciliation are performed. Once backfill completes, finance will post final adjustment and reverse provisional credit if necessary."
omar_finance: tweak: include invoice id and reference to ticket. final revrec should include JE: Debit Revenue $1,120.00, Credit Customer Credit Liability $1,120.00. I'll draft and circulate.
lisa_support: told customer we'll issue a provisional credit immediately and follow up with a final reconciliation within 7 business days. customer asked for timeline — shared ETA 72 hours for backfill run + 48 hours for finance posting.
devon_engineer: remediation plan: 1) revert ingester change that altered dedupe-key (hotfix) — already rolled back at 2026-03-06T08:10Z, 2) run backfill dedupe job across 2026-03-01..2026-03-07 (started), 3) re-run ledgerization job and produce reconciliation report, 4) post final invoice adjustment. backfill progress: currently 40% scanned, estimated completion 24h.
sam_infra: added monitoring check to fail deploy if dedupe-key mapping changes. also added a one-off alert for double-event spikes.
metering-bot: backfill job job-789 progress: 40% processed, expected end 2026-03-08T02:15Z.
ingrid_billing: once backfill completes, finance wants a CSV with original ledger rows and corrected rows for the revrec audit.
devon_engineer: will attach reconciliation CSV and a short root-cause writeup to the ticket.
omar_finance: provisional credit of $1,120 issued to account org_4567 (we used simple unit pricing to estimate). finance will update revrec docs and create JE drafts.
lisa_support: customer confirmed provisional credit posted within 30 minutes, appreciates quick response. they want confirmation when final invoice is posted.
devon_engineer: backfill completed and reconciliation shows corrected tokens = 112,030. duplicates removed: 1,008,373 tokens. ledger corrected. attaching final CSV: /internal/exports/org_4567_reconciled_202603.csv
omar_finance: final adjustment posted: credit $1,120. Final revrec note saved in finance drive and linked to INV-2026-03-07-9987. JE posted.
ingrid_billing: closing loop with billing: invoice updated, statement sent to customer, and audit trail includes deploy-345 root-cause.
lisa_support: customer replied: thanks for proactive handling; closing their ticket. marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
devon_engineer: root cause summary for postmortem: regression in dedupe-key composition in ingester (deploy-345) allowed retries/reconnects to produce distinct dedupe keys resulting in double-counting in the ledger pipeline. fix: revert + stronger integration test + deploy gating + alerting.
metering-bot: incident note created: MET-2026-03-05-duplicated-usage-events.
sam_infra: follow-up action item: add e2e smoke that simulates reconnect + replay and asserts dedupe. assigned to eng-infra.
omar_finance: thanks all. finance closure: provisional credit $1,120 reconciled and final JE posted. marking finance side resolved.
